intro: For nine years I have recorded rainforests, rivers and volcanoes through Heart in Nature. I study how sound moves through the body and the nervous system, and I turn those recordings into tools you can play.

research.title: Psychoacoustics
research.text: How the ear and brain turn vibration into feeling. The heart of my Master's in Sound Art.

research.title: Bioacoustics
research.text: The voices of living ecosystems, recorded and archived from Central America.

research.title: 3D sound
research.text: Binaural and ambisonic environments for installations, planetariums and headphones.
